payload.title: Story variations and a conversation for each Story
payload.description: An editor sees several ways a new item could connect to what the newsroom knows (another Reference, a Story, a Concept), each as a StoryVariation, and talks to the Story's own agent to get new ones, for example: combine the Story from A with the concept from B and ignore C. Design: docs/story-variations.md. Ryan 2026-11-02.
